sources.quote: "From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used 5% of the time. You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you're trying to deal with this very supply-constrained environment. And somehow many people's intuition is the opposite of that." (Tom's Hardware, 30 Oct 16:28Z, re-read 03:47Z 31 Oct; said while discussing local inference on home computers)
